articles.title: 完型 · 2009年猪流感全球疫情
articles.context: 公共卫生与全球猪流感疫情。文章按照疫情被认定、全球扩散、美国病例变化和疫苗供应展开，数字与公共卫生措施较密集，朗读保持新闻报道式的清晰和克制。
rows: The outbreak of swine flu that was first detected in Mexico was declared a global epidemic on June 11, 2009.
最早在墨西哥发现的猪流感疫情，于2009年6月11日被宣布为全球性流行病。
opening
It is the first worldwide epidemic designated by the World Health Organization in 41 years.
这是世界卫生组织41年来首次认定的全球性流行病。
report
The heightened alert prompted an emergency meeting with flu experts in Geneva that assembled after a sharp rise in cases in Australia, and rising numbers in Britain, Japan, Chile and elsewhere.
警戒级别的提高促使流感专家在日内瓦召开紧急会议；此前澳大利亚病例急剧增加，英国、日本、智利等地的病例数也在上升。
advance

But the epidemic is “moderate” in severity, according to Margaret Chan, the organization’s director general, with the overwhelming majority of patients experiencing only mild symptoms and a full recovery, often in the absence of any medical treatment.
不过，世界卫生组织总干事陈冯富珍表示，这场疫情的严重程度“中等”，绝大多数患者只有轻微症状并能完全康复，而且往往无需任何医疗干预。
contrast
The outbreak came to global notice in late April 2009, when Mexican authorities noted an unusually large number of hospitalizations and deaths among healthy adults.
2009年4月下旬，这场疫情开始引起全球关注，当时墨西哥当局注意到健康成年人中出现了异常大量的住院和死亡病例。
history
As much of Mexico City shut down at the height of a panic, cases began to crop up in New York City, the southwestern United States and around the world.
在恐慌最严重时，墨西哥城大面积停摆；与此同时，纽约市、美国西南部以及世界各地开始陆续出现病例。
advance
In the United States, new cases seemed to fade as warmer weather arrived.
在美国，随着天气转暖，新增病例似乎逐渐减少。
contrast

But in late September 2009, officials reported there was significant flu activity in almost every state and that virtually all the samples tested are the new swine flu, also known as A/H1N1, not seasonal flu.
但到2009年9月下旬，官员报告说几乎每个州都有显著的流感活动，而且检测的样本几乎全部属于新型猪流感，即A/H1N1，而不是季节性流感。
evidence
In the U.S., it has infected more than one million people, and caused more than 600 deaths and more than 6,000 hospitalizations.
在美国，它已经感染了100多万人，造成600多人死亡、6000多人住院。
statistic
Federal health officials released Tamiflu for children from the national stockpile and began taking orders from the states for the new swine flu vaccine.
联邦卫生官员从国家储备中发放儿童用达菲，并开始接受各州对新型猪流感疫苗的订购。
report
The new vaccine, which is different from the annual flu vaccine, is available ahead of expectations.
这种新疫苗不同于每年的季节性流感疫苗，其供应时间早于预期。
report

More than three million doses were to be made available in early October 2009, though most of those initial doses were of the FluMist nasal spray type, which is not recommended for pregnant women, people over 50 or those with breathing difficulties, heart disease or several other problems.
2009年10月初将有300多万剂疫苗可供使用，不过其中大多数首批疫苗属于FluMist鼻喷剂型，不建议孕妇、50岁以上人群，以及患有呼吸困难、心脏病或其他若干疾病的人使用。
detail
But it was still possible to vaccinate people in other high-risk groups: health care workers, people caring for infants and healthy young people.
不过，仍然可以为其他高风险人群接种，包括医护人员、照料婴儿的人以及健康的年轻人。
conclude

articles.title: 阅读一 · 金融危机后的艺术市场下行
articles.context: 艺术市场与金融危机。文章以 Damien Hirst 拍卖与雷曼破产同日发生切入，描述艺术市场由繁荣转向下行，并指出当前最大问题不是没有买家，而是优质作品供应不足。语气分析、克制，关键数字和因果转折处加强重音。
rows: The longest bull run in a century of art-market history ended on a dramatic note with a sale of 56 works by Damien Hirst, Beautiful Inside My Head Forever, at Sotheby's in London on September 15th 2008.
艺术市场一个世纪以来持续时间最长的牛市，以一种戏剧性的方式收场：2008年9月15日，达明安·赫斯特的56件作品《我脑海中永远美丽》在伦敦苏富比拍卖。
opening
longest bull run
dramatic note
September 15th 2008
All but two pieces sold, fetching more than £70m, a record for a sale by a single artist.
除两件作品外，其余全部成交，总额超过7000万英镑，创下单一艺术家专场拍卖的新纪录。

就在拍卖师不断报出竞价时，纽约华尔街历史最悠久的银行之一雷曼兄弟申请破产。

艺术经济研究公司创始人克莱尔·麦克安德鲁估计，2007年市场巅峰时规模约为650亿美元，是五年前的两倍。

然而，这个市场受到的关注远远超过其规模本身，因为很少有其他行业能像它这样，把巨额财富、强烈自我、贪婪、激情和争议汇聚在一起。

In the weeks and months that followed Mr. Hirst's sale, spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable.
赫斯特拍卖后的数周乃至数月里，各种形式的消费都迅速变得不合时宜。

In the art world that meant collectors stayed away from galleries and salerooms.
在艺术界，这意味着收藏家开始远离画廊和拍卖场。

Sales of contemporary art fell by two-thirds, and in the most overheated sector, they were down by nearly 90% in the year to November 2008.
当代艺术品销售额下降了三分之二；在此前最为过热的领域，截至2008年11月的一年里，跌幅接近90%。

Within weeks the world's two biggest auction houses, Sotheby's and Christie's, had to pay out nearly $200m in guarantees to clients who had placed works for sale with them.
短短数周内，全球两大拍卖行苏富比和佳士得就不得不向委托其出售作品的客户支付近2亿美元的保底款。

The current downturn in the art market is the worst since the Japanese stopped buying Impressionists at the end of 1989.

This time experts reckon that prices are about 40% down on their peak on average, though some have been far more fluctuant.
专家估计，这一次艺术品价格平均已比峰值下降约40%，不过有些品类的波动更为剧烈。

But Edward Dolman, Christie's chief executive, says: ‘I'm pretty confident we're at the bottom.’
但佳士得首席执行官爱德华·多尔曼表示：“我相当确信，我们已经触底。”

What makes this slump different from the last, he says, is that there are still buyers in the market.
他说，这次低迷与上一次不同之处在于，市场上仍然存在买家。

The three Ds – death, debt and divorce – still deliver works of art to the market.

articles.title: 阅读二 · 夫妻之间不同的谈话期待
articles.context: 婚姻沟通与性别谈话模式。文章以一次家庭聚会中的反差场景开篇，转向研究数据，说明男性在公共场合往往说得更多、回家后却更沉默，而许多妻子首先期待丈夫成为谈话伙伴。语气自然、观察性强，笑点、反差和核心结论处加强重音。
rows: I was addressing a small gathering in a suburban Virginia living room – a women's group that had invited men to join them.
我当时正在弗吉尼亚郊区一间客厅里的小型聚会上讲话；这是一个女性团体举办的活动，也邀请了男性参加。
story
small gathering

Throughout the evening, one man had been particularly talkative, frequently offering ideas and anecdotes, while his wife sat silently beside him on the couch.
整个晚上，一名男子格外健谈，不断发表观点、讲述轶事，而他的妻子则一直安静地坐在沙发上他的身旁。

Toward the end of the evening, I commented that women frequently complain that their husbands don't talk to them.

This man quickly nodded in agreement.

He gestured toward his wife and said, ‘She's the talker in our family.’
他指着妻子说：“在我们家，她才是那个爱说话的人。”
quote

The room burst into laughter; the man looked puzzled and hurt.
全屋的人顿时笑了起来；那个男人却显得既困惑又受伤。
contrast

‘It's true,’ he explained.
“这是真的。”他解释道。

‘When I come home from work I have nothing to say.
“我下班回家以后根本没什么可说的。

If she didn't keep the conversation going, we'd spend the whole evening in silence.’
如果她不主动维持谈话，我们整个晚上都会一言不发。”
quote

This episode crystallizes the irony that although American men tend to talk more than women in public situations, they often talk less at home.
这一幕鲜明体现了一个讽刺现象：美国男性在公共场合往往比女性说得更多，但在家里却常常说得更少。

And this pattern is wreaking havoc with marriage.
而这种模式正在给婚姻造成严重破坏。

The pattern was observed by political scientist Andrew Hacker in the late 1970s.
政治学家安德鲁·哈克早在20世纪70年代末就观察到了这种模式。

Andrew Hacker

Sociologist Catherine Kohler Riessman reports in her new book Divorce Talk that most of the women she interviewed – but only a few of the men – gave lack of communication as the reason for their divorces.
社会学家凯瑟琳·科勒·里斯曼在新书《离婚之谈》中指出，她采访的大多数女性——但只有少数男性——都把缺乏沟通列为离婚原因。

Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year – a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
考虑到目前接近50%的离婚率，这意味着美国每年有数百万起这样的案例，几乎形成了一场“谈话失败”的流行病。

articles.title: 阅读三 · 商业如何塑造消费者习惯
articles.context: 消费心理、习惯形成与商业推广。文章从企业利用日常线索塑造自动化行为讲起，再以刷牙、瓶装水、口香糖等案例说明“制造习惯”的商业力量，并在结尾指出由此引发的争议。
rows: Over the past decade, many companies had perfected the art of creating automatic behaviors — habits — among consumers.
过去十年间，许多公司已经把在消费者中塑造自动化行为——也就是习惯——这门艺术磨练得炉火纯青。
report
These habits have helped companies earn billions of dollars when customers eat snacks or wipe counters almost without thinking, often in response to a carefully designed set of daily cues.
这些习惯帮助企业赚取了数十亿美元：顾客几乎不经思考就吃零食或擦拭台面，而这种行为往往是对一套精心设计的日常线索作出的反应。
explain

“There are fundamental public health problems, like dirty hands instead of a soap habit, that remain killers only because we can’t figure out how to change people’s habits,” said Dr. Curtis, the director of the Hygiene Center at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine.
伦敦卫生与热带医学院卫生中心主任柯蒂斯博士说：“有一些根本性的公共卫生问题，比如人们手脏却没有用肥皂洗手的习惯；它们之所以仍然致命，只是因为我们还不知道怎样改变人的习惯。”
quote
“We wanted to learn from private industry how to create new behaviors that happen automatically.”
“我们想向私营企业学习，看看怎样才能创造出会自动发生的新行为。”
quote

The companies that Dr. Curtis turned to — Procter & Gamble, Colgate- Palmolive and Unilever — had invested hundreds of millions of dollars finding the subtle cues in consumers’ lives that corporations could use to introduce new routines.
柯蒂斯博士求助的那些公司——宝洁、高露洁-棕榄和联合利华——已经投入数亿美元，寻找消费者生活中的细微信号，以便企业利用这些信号引入新的日常行为模式。
report

If you look hard enough, you’ll find that many of the products we use every day — chewing gums, skin moisturizers, disinfecting wipes, air fresheners, water purifiers, health snacks, teeth whiteners, fabric softeners, vitamins — are results of manufactured habits.
只要仔细观察就会发现，我们每天使用的许多产品——口香糖、润肤霜、消毒湿巾、空气清新剂、净水器、健康零食、牙齿美白产品、柔顺剂、维生素——其实都是人为塑造习惯的结果。
explain
A century ago, few people regularly brushed their teeth multiple times a day.
一个世纪以前，很少有人一天多次定期刷牙。
history

Today, because of shrewd advertising and public health campaigns, many Americans habitually give their pearly whites a cavity-preventing scrub twice a day, often with Colgate, Crest or one of the other brands.
如今，由于精明的广告和公共卫生宣传，许多美国人已经习惯每天两次给一口白牙做防龋清洁，往往使用高露洁、佳洁士或其他品牌的牙膏。
evidence
A few decades ago, many people didn’t drink water outside of a meal.
几十年前，许多人除了吃饭时并不喝水。
history
Then beverage companies started bottling the production of far-off springs, and now office workers unthinkingly sip bottled water all day long.
后来饮料公司开始把遥远泉源的水装瓶出售，如今办公室职员整天都会不假思索地啜饮瓶装水。
sequence
Chewing gum, once bought primarily by adolescent boys, is now featured in commercials as a breath freshener and teeth cleanser for use after a meal.
口香糖过去主要由青春期男孩购买，如今广告则把它塑造成饭后用来清新口气、清洁牙齿的产品。
example
Skin moisturizers are advertised as part of morning beauty rituals, slipped in between hair brushing and putting on makeup.
润肤霜也被宣传为晨间美容仪式的一部分，被安排在梳头和化妆之间使用。
example

“Our products succeed when they become part of daily or weekly patterns,” said Carol Berning, a consumer psychologist who recently retired from Procter & Gamble, the company that sold $76 billion of Tide, Crest and other products last year.
消费者心理学家卡罗尔·伯宁最近从宝洁退休；她说：“当我们的产品成为人们每日或每周生活模式的一部分时，它们就成功了。”宝洁去年销售了价值760亿美元的汰渍、佳洁士等产品。
quote
“Creating positive habits is a huge part of improving our consumers’ lives, and it’s essential to making new products commercially viable.”
“培养积极习惯，是改善消费者生活的重要组成部分，也是让新产品具备商业可行性的关键。”
emphasize
Through experiments and observation, social scientists like Dr. Berning have learned that there is power in tying certain behaviors to habitual cues through ruthless advertising.
通过实验和观察，伯宁博士这样的社会科学家已经发现，借助强势广告把某些行为与习惯性线索绑定起来，具有强大的力量。
explain
As this new science of habit has emerged, controversies have erupted when the tactics have been used to sell questionable beauty creams or unhealthy foods.
随着这门新的习惯科学兴起，当这些手法被用来推销可疑的美容霜或不健康食品时，也引发了争议。
contrast

articles.title: 阅读四 · 美国陪审团制度的民主化改革
articles.context: 陪审团制度、民主价值与反歧视改革。文章先说明陪审团体现的民主原则，再回顾1968年前精英陪审团与女性排斥问题，最后讲述联邦立法和最高法院判决如何推动制度改革。
rows: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values, including the principles that all citizens who meet minimal qualifications of age and literacy are equally competent to serve on juries; that jurors should be selected randomly from a representative cross section of the community; that no citizen should be denied the right to serve on a jury on account of race, religion, sex, or national origin; that defendants are entitled to trial by their peers; and that verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law.
许多美国人把陪审团制度视为重要民主价值的具体体现，其中包括：所有达到最低年龄和识字要求的公民都同样有资格担任陪审员；陪审员应从具有代表性的社区横截面中随机选出；任何公民都不应因种族、宗教、性别或国籍而被剥夺担任陪审员的权利；被告有权接受同侪审判；裁决应体现社区的良知，而不能只体现法律条文。
explain
The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy.
陪审团还被认为是现存最好的直接民主而非代议民主的范例。
emphasize
In a direct democracy, citizens take turns governing themselves, rather than electing representatives to govern for them.
在直接民主中，公民轮流治理自己，而不是选出代表来治理他们。
define
But as recently as in 1968, jury selection procedures conflicted with these democratic ideals.
然而，直到1968年，陪审员遴选程序仍与这些民主理想相冲突。
contrast
In some states, for example, jury duty was limited to persons of supposedly superior intelligence, education, and moral character.
例如，在一些州，陪审义务只限于那些被认为智力、教育程度和道德品质更优越的人。
example

Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.
尽管美国最高法院早在1880年的“斯特劳德诉西弗吉尼亚州案”中就已禁止在陪审员遴选中进行故意的种族歧视，但挑选所谓精英陪审团或“蓝带陪审团”的做法，为规避这项以及其他反歧视法律提供了便利途径。
history
The system also failed to regularly include women on juries until the mid-20th century.
直到20世纪中叶，这套制度也未能经常让女性进入陪审团。
history
Although women first served on state juries in Utah in 1898, it was not until the 1940s that a majority of states made women eligible for jury duty.
尽管女性早在1898年就在犹他州担任州级陪审员，但直到20世纪40年代，大多数州才赋予女性担任陪审员的资格。
history
Even then several states automatically exempted women from jury duty unless they personally asked to have their names included on the jury list.
即使如此，一些州仍会自动免除女性的陪审义务，除非她们本人提出申请，要求把自己的姓名列入陪审员名单。
contrast
This practice was justified by the claim that women were needed at home, and it kept juries unrepresentative of women through the 1960s.
这种做法以“女性需要留在家中”为理由，并使陪审团直到20世纪60年代仍无法充分代表女性。
explain
In 1968, the Congress of the United States passed the Jury Selection and Service Act, ushering in a new era of democratic reforms for the jury.
1968年，美国国会通过《陪审员遴选与服务法》，为陪审团的民主化改革开启了一个新时代。
advance
This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community.
这项法律取消了对联邦陪审员的特殊教育要求，并规定应从整个社区的横截面中随机选取陪审员。
explain
In the landmark 1975 decision Taylor v. Louisiana, the Supreme Court extended the requirement that juries be representative of all parts of the community to the state level.
在具有里程碑意义的1975年“泰勒诉路易斯安那州案”裁决中，最高法院把“陪审团必须代表社区各个部分”的要求扩展到了州一级。
history
The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
泰勒案的裁决还宣布陪审员遴选中的性别歧视违宪，并要求各州采用相同程序挑选男性和女性陪审员。
conclude

articles.title: 新题型 · 模仿鸟群编队节省航空燃料
articles.context: 仿生航空与节能。文章从鸟类V字编队的上洗气流原理出发，讨论客机编队飞行可能带来的燃油与排放收益，并依次评估安全、空管、天气和航班协调等现实障碍。
rows: Both Boeing and Airbus have trumpeted the efficiency of their newest aircraft, the 787 and A350 respectively.
波音和空客都大力宣扬各自最新机型——787和A350——的高效率。
report
Their clever designs and lightweight composites certainly make a difference.
巧妙的设计和轻质复合材料当然确实发挥了作用。
explain

But a group of researchers at Stanford University, led by Ilan Kroo, has suggested that airlines could take a more naturalistic approach to cutting jet-fuel use and it would not require them to buy new aircraft.
但由伊兰·克鲁带领的一组斯坦福大学研究人员提出，航空公司还可以采用一种更接近自然的方法来减少喷气燃料消耗，而且无需购买新飞机。
advance
The answer, says Dr. Kroo, lies with birds.
克鲁博士说，答案就在鸟类身上。
emphasize
Since 1914, scientists have known that birds flying in formation — a V-shape — expend less energy.
早在1914年，科学家就知道，鸟类以V字形编队飞行时消耗的能量更少。
history
The air flowing over a bird’s wings curls upwards behind the wingtips, a phenomenon known as upwash.
气流掠过鸟翼后，会在翼尖后方向上卷起，这种现象称为上洗气流。
explain
Other birds flying in the upwash experience reduced drag, and spend less energy propelling themselves.
其他飞在上洗气流中的鸟会受到更小的阻力，因此推进自身所需的能量也更少。
explain
Peter Lissaman, an aeronautics expert who was formerly at Caltech and the University of Southern California, has suggested that a formation of 25 birds might enjoy a range increase of 71%.
曾任职于加州理工学院和南加州大学的航空学专家彼得·利萨曼认为，25只鸟组成的编队可能使航程增加71%。
statistic
When applied to aircraft, the principles are not substantially different.
把这些原理应用到飞机上，并没有本质区别。
transition

Dr. Kroo and his team modeled what would happen if three passenger jets departing from Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas were to assemble over Utah, assume an inverted V-formation, occasionally change places so all could have a turn in the most favourable positions, and proceed to London.
克鲁博士及其团队模拟了这样一种情形：三架分别从洛杉矶、旧金山和拉斯维加斯起飞的客机在犹他州上空会合，组成倒V字形编队，并不时交换位置，让每架飞机都能轮流处于最有利的位置，然后飞往伦敦。
example
They found that the aircraft consumed as much as 15% less fuel (coupled with a reduction in carbon-dioxide output).
他们发现，飞机最多可以少消耗15%的燃料，同时还能减少二氧化碳排放。
statistic
Nitrogen-oxide emissions during the cruising portions of the flight fell by around a quarter.
在巡航阶段，氮氧化物排放量下降了约四分之一。
statistic
There are, of course, knots to be worked out.
当然，其中还有一些难题需要解决。
contrast
One consideration is safety, or at least the perception of it.
一个问题是安全，或者至少是人们对安全的感受。
explain
Would passengers feel comfortable travelling in companion?
乘客会愿意在这样的结伴编队中飞行吗？
ask
Dr. Kroo points out that the aircraft could be separated by several nautical miles, and would not be in the intimate groupings favoured by display teams like the Red Arrows.
克鲁博士指出，飞机之间可以相隔数海里，不会像“红箭”之类的飞行表演队那样紧密编组。
explain
A passenger peering out of the window might not even see the other planes.
乘客从舷窗向外看，甚至可能根本看不到其他飞机。
explain

Whether the separation distances involved would satisfy air-traffic-control regulations is another matter, although a working group at the International Civil Aviation Organisation has included the possibility of formation flying in a blueprint for new operational guidelines.
不过，这样的间隔距离能否满足空中交通管制规定则是另一回事；国际民用航空组织的一个工作组已经把编队飞行的可能性纳入新的运行指南蓝图之中。
qualify
It remains to be seen how weather conditions affect the air flows that make formation flight more efficient.
天气条件会怎样影响使编队飞行更高效的气流，目前仍有待观察。
advance
In zones of increased turbulence, the planes’ wakes will decay more quickly and the effect will diminish.
在湍流增强的区域，飞机尾流会更快衰减，节能效果也会减弱。
explain
Dr. Kroo says this is one of the areas his team will investigate further.
克鲁博士表示，这是他的团队将进一步研究的领域之一。
report
It might also be hard for airlines to co-ordinate the departure times and destinations of passenger aircraft in a way that would allow them to gain from formation flight.
航空公司还可能很难协调客机的起飞时间和目的地，从而让它们能够从编队飞行中获益。
qualify
Cargo aircraft, in contrast, might be easier to reschedule, as might routine military flights.
相比之下，货机可能更容易重新安排时刻，常规军用飞行也可能如此。
contrast
As it happens, America’s armed forces are on the case already.
事实上，美国军方已经在研究这件事。
advance
Earlier this year the country’s Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency announced plans to pay Boeing to investigate formation flight, though the programme has yet to begin.
今年早些时候，美国国防高级研究计划局宣布计划出资让波音研究编队飞行，不过该项目尚未启动。
report
There are reports that some military aircraft flew in formation when they were low on fuel during the Second World War, but Dr. Lissaman says they are unsubstantiated.
有报道称，第二次世界大战期间一些军用飞机在燃料不足时曾采用编队飞行，但利萨曼博士说这些说法并未得到证实。
qualify
“My father was an RAF pilot and my cousin the skipper of a Lancaster lost over Berlin,” he adds.
他补充说：“我父亲曾是英国皇家空军飞行员，我的表兄则是一架在柏林上空失踪的兰开斯特轰炸机机长。”
quote
So he should know.
所以，他理应对此有所了解。
conclude

articles.title: 翻译 · 可持续价值如何落实到日常选择
articles.context: 英语二整段翻译。文章借 Ted Ning 的职业挫折解释‘可持续性’为何成为个人价值选择，不使用46-50五句式结构，而按原卷整段切句对齐。语气真诚、克制，个人经历和价值转折处有自然重音。
